jobs.description: Douglas Service GmbHOur Finance Solutions team is responsible for the SAP-based finance processes across the DOUGLAS Group. Together, we standardise, harmonise and simplify finance processes across all markets. In doing so, we deliver stable, future-proof solutions for Europe's leading omnichannel provider of premium beauty.We are looking for you as Senior SAP Finance Consultant to actively shape the future of our global finance system landscape. In this role, you combine in-depth SAP Financial Accounting expertise with a strong understanding of processes, and you drive transformation projects in the SAP S/4HANA environment. Would you like to design finance processes across borders and take ownership of international projects? A committed team is looking forward to welcoming you.TASKS WITH IMPACT- You take functional responsibility for our SAP Finance solutions and advise the finance departments across the DOUGLAS Group on efficient and sustainable processes- Analysing business requirements, you develop suitable solutions within the SAP standard and through targeted enhancements- Designing and optimising end-to-end processes is at the heart of your role, with a focus on Financial Accounting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Asset Accounting as well as banking and payment processes- Seamless integration between SAP Financial Accounting and adjacent modules such as Sales & Distribution and Materials Management is your responsibility- Leading projects and sub-projects independently, you coordinate collaboration with internal and external stakeholders- As part of transformation and digitalisation initiatives, particularly in the SAP S/4HANA environment, you advance our finance system landscape. You also drive the standardisation, harmonisation and simplification of finance processes across all DOUGLAS markets- Together with developers, key users and business departments, you ensure high quality in our solutions and processesYOUR SKILLS- You hold a degree in business informatics or business administration, or a comparable qualification- Several years of professional experience as an SAP Financial Accounting Consultant in international SAP landscapes have given you very good knowledge of SAP Financial Accounting- Your solid understanding of how Sales & Distribution and Materials Management integrate with Financial Accounting is complemented by experience in designing and implementing finance processes and system solutions- Experience in steering projects or sub-projects is part of your background, and you are happy to get hands-on with implementation in the system- Breaking down complex requirements in a structured way, you translate them into viable solutions and align them purposefully with stakeholders at different levels- Ideally, you bring experience with SAP S/4HANA or SAP transformation projects. Knowledge of SAP integrations and interfaces, e-invoicing and digital compliance requirements, as well as agile ways of working and ITIL-based service processes, is also desirable- You communicate confidently in German and English, both spoken and written

jobs.description: In this role, you will drive the efficiency of the global Stage-Gate process for product development across LIXIL's brands and regions. You are the operational engine behind our R&D delivery: ensuring clear work packages, disciplined gate transitions, and practical governance that project teams can easily adopt. As the primary subject matter expert, you will serve as the trusted advisor for project managers and gatekeepers on all process inquiries.The role works through influence across a matrixed, multi-cultural organisation and is a service to colleagues rather than an audit function. R&D is in active transformation on tooling and data quality, so ambiguity and shifting priorities are part of the job.Your Responsibilities:- Drive continuous optimisation of the global Stage-Gate Work Packages, ensuring deliverables are lean, consistent and harmonised across brands and regions.- Maintain and enforce the global R&D governance framework: processes, tools, RASCI models, cadence structures and compliance checkpoints.- Safeguard gate readiness, documentation integrity and audit readiness across all gate transitions.- Define, track and report R&D KPIs covering gate discipline, cycle time and pipeline health.- Develop and maintain digitalized templates, blueprints, work instructions and process documentation that simplify execution for project managers.- Coordinate cross-functional and cross-regional alignment, so local delivery conforms to global R&D standards.- Ensure Stage-Gate documentation and gate data are captured consistently and kept current in the governing systems, and represent process requirements towards the system owners.- Build and maintain the R&D Knowledge Hub as the single, topic-structured source for process documentation, templates and training material, curated as an ongoing exercise.- Ensure data continuity between Stage-Gate governance and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), acting as the business-side representative to translate process requirements into system specifications with the Global PLM team.Your Profile:- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business Management, Industrial Management or comparable.- 7 to 10 years in process management, R&D project management or operational excellence, gained across more than one industry, ideally in product development or manufacturing.- Proven implementation of Stage-Gate or comparable phase-gate models- Working understanding of project and portfolio management systems used in an R&D environment (e.g. Planisware Orchestra, SAP) and good data literacy for KPI definition and process analysis.- Interest in how AI, automation and digital tools can simplify product development processes.- Solid understanding of PLM, ERP, and engineering change management systems (e.g., SAP, Planisware Orchestra), with the ability to align process governance with system architecture.- Demonstrated comfort, curiosity and respect across cultures and working styles is a core requirement.- Gives and receives feedback constructively.- Lean, Six Sigma or comparable optimisation approaches an advantage.- Strong moderation and stakeholder skills, able to steer cross-regional teams without direct reporting lines. Able to translate between technical detail and business framing.- Business-fluent English required, German an advantage.Our offer:- A salary package that ties directly to your work experience and responsibilities- Comprehensive health management, including an on-site fitness room, local and digital health services, Health Cashback, and Hansefit membership- Diversity & Inclusion: We offer equal opportunities for all individuals and support your personal development- Access to a wide range of employee benefits, such as discounts on travel, fashion, media, mobile phones, and more- A highly motivated, appreciative, and international team that inspires you and offers opportunities to learn and grow- A modern company restaurant to ensure your well-being during the dayInterested?Then we are looking forward to your application!
